evals.name: explicit-multi-quote-request
evals.prompt: Build me a scope reference for Northwind comparing Q-000101 (Starter), Q-000102 (Growth), and Q-000103 (Enterprise). Client-facing.
evals.expected_output: Static branded HTML: 3 option cards + one line-item matrix with hours anchor, states validated 1:1 against the three live quotes, prices from timeline snapshots, no per-item dollars, prose gate passed.

evals.name: implicit-trigger-no-skill-word
evals.prompt: I need a one-pager that shows what's in each tier for the Acme deal side by side so I can walk the client through it.
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers despite no 'scope reference' phrase. Resolves Acme quotes, builds the same static side-by-side artifact.

evals.name: should-NOT-trigger-interactive
evals.prompt: Make me a clickable interactive proposal page for Q-000200 where the prospect can switch between versions.
evals.expected_output: This skill should DEFER to interactive-proposal (click-through, version switcher). Correct behavior is NOT to build the static scope reference.

evals.name: two-staffing-variants
evals.prompt: Scope reference for Contoso, two options (Q-000301, Q-000302), and show both the onshore and nearshore pricing so they can compare.
evals.expected_output: Reads each variant as its own snapshot (own hours/weeks/revenue), builds the neutral toggle, defaults to onshore, does not assume hours match across variants.

evals.name: single-option-no-tiers
evals.prompt: Can you make a scope reference for the Globex project? It's just one quote, Q-000400, no tiers.
evals.expected_output: Single-option mode: one summary panel (not a card row), in/optional matrix (no available/out columns, no comparison), same brand + hours anchor + gates. Skill announces single-option mode.
